messages:
raj: Heads-up — running the Q3 int8 candidate on the OCR->translate pipeline and seeing repeated hallucinated context when input has hard line breaks (vertical layout, Han characters). BLEU drops look real. :eyes:

lucia: Can you paste a tiny repro + metric delta?

raj: Minimal repro (staging q3 vs baseline fp16):
```
input: "第1行。\n第2行。\n第3行。"
baseline translation: "Line 1. Line 2. Line 3."
q3 int8 translation: "Line 1. [SECTION_START] Line 2. strange_token Line 3."
```
BLEU: baseline 31.8 -> q3 24.6 on hk-vertical-ocr-devset (n=2.1k). EM-like exact match falls by ~18%.

kai: Hmm, the inserted token looks like our detokenizer placeholder for softline. Any chance the tokenizer emitted ZWSP/ZWJ variants or U+2028?

raj: Yes, the raw tokenizer logs show extra U+2060-like markers around line boundaries after quantized kernel selection. Example tokenized ids: [1045, 0x2060, 2093, ...] only on q3.

emily: Could be a kernel fallback for the BPE merge loop under the new quant path — we saw non-deterministic merges in earlier q5 bringups. Does this reproduce with --no-kernel-fallback?

raj: Repro steps I ran:
1) docker image: redwood/q3-int8:v2026-03-20
2) curl -X POST staging.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"q3-int8","input":"<file-with-vertical-lines>"}'
3) compare with baseline fp16 image
It fails consistently on that devset.

lucia: Can you dump the tokenizer detok mapping for that sample? Also include the raw bytes (hex) around the line break.

raj: Attached snippets below (pasted inline):
```
raw bytes around break: e4 b8 80 e3 80 82 0a e4 b8 81 e3 80 82
detok mapping: 0x0A -> \u2028? (unexpected)
```

kai: @raj thanks. I pushed a quick branch that disables in-kernel merge optimization for the multilingual BPE and forces the reference merge loop: branch/kerndebug/q3-detok-skip. If you can repro against that build it would tell us if the quantized kernel is to blame.

ops-bot: Canary alert: q3-int8 (canary-7) failed detok-smoke (regression > 5 pts) — automated rollback queued.

raj: Ran @kai's build — diff looks promising. BLEU recovered to 30.9, hallucinated token gone. So likely kernel selection bug in quant path.

emily: Good signal. Next steps: kai to bisect kernel changes (new int8 merge op + caching), eng-runtime to add a targeted unit test for linebreak+han merging, and rl-evals to rerun full hk/vertical devset once patch is in.

kai: On it — I'll open a PR with kernel guard and a deterministic test. Will include the exact failing token ids and the quick repro harness.

lucia: Also let's add a CI check: run detok roundtrip for sample sets with vertical whitespace and failing locales. Add as flaky test until fixed.

raj: Thanks all. Keeping the canary rollback as-is until PR lands + green.

emily: FYI, filed a short incident note in #incidents with links to the devset and the q3 canary logs.

raj: TL;DR: quant kernel path introduced a merge/detok edgecase around linebreaks in CJK vertical OCR transcripts; quick mitigation is forcing reference-merge kernel; full fix will be kernel-guard + unit tests.
